question: In January 2025, which of the following states signed an MoU with State Bank of India and Union bank of India to offer zero-premium insurance to government employees?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **January 2025**, the **Assam Government** signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the **State Bank of India (SBI)** and **Union Bank of India** to provide financial security to its workforce.
 
• The primary objective of this agreement is to offer **zero-premium personal accident insurance** coverage to approximately **4.25 lakh permanent state government employees**.
 
• Under this arrangement, employees do not have to pay any monthly or annual charges to avail of the insurance benefits, as the coverage is linked to their **salary accounts** maintained with these banks.
 
• The MoU was finalized in the presence of Chief Minister **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, who emphasized the state’s commitment to the **welfare** and **social security** of its employees and their families.
